correctness.rationale: Exhaustive C++17 code enumerates precisely all 2^21 and 2^22 host masks and all 429 recursively generated Dyck targets; direct greedy matching is equivalent to subsequence containment. value.rationale: A natural complete Catalan language of 429 length-14 targets has a well-defined exact shortest common subsequence-cover invariant. The exact minimum 22 and unique optimal literal host supply a complete previously unlocated finite cutoff and an unexpectedly rigid extremal classification, suitable as a benchmark in word compression and sequence embedding. This is not a mere Catalan count or general SCS algorithm application.
